answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the shale of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, clawed back after a replayed submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Every claim climbs the ridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the anchor re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
